pass_1.finding: Prints v1 RT2 and PCR primers, useful for comparison but not proof of v2 primer identity; the v2 author protocol settles the latter independently.

pass_2.locations: Original Jaitin 2014 Supplementary Tables S7–S8 local scg_jaitin-sm.pdf.txt lines 23–67; coauthor-uploaded full original Methods lines 254–324, 326–390
pass_2.finding: Independently compared v1 RT1, RT2, ligation adapter and PCR oligos with v2. The v1 Methods pool first-strand cDNA before Exo I, then pool again before second-strand synthesis and IVT; v2 authors’ protocols.io uses Exo I in individual wells before pooling. These are protocol-specific orders and oligo identities, not a common inherited sequence claim.

missing_claims.evidence: The checked author procedure supplies amplification-primer flanks, while an independent review of instrument information and linked resources is pending.

missing_claims.claim: The supplementary read-design field says 3I while the v2 adapter table shows N5
missing_claims.evidence: MOESM1 seq_batches.txt field description prints 3I.4P.50M; MOESM5 ligation-adapter rows print five random bases before the four-base pool barcode. The public page identifies both, models N5, and leaves the carryover explanation uncertain.

conclusion: Pass 1 corrected the missing RT2/PCR claim; pass 2 and an inaccessible linked resource remain pending.
